text: Multiply and divide scalars and nonscalars or multiply and invert matrices, 6 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Mode} sets Select data type mode; {Number of inputs} controls number of inputs and type, {Multiplication} sets the element-wise, {Apply over} sets how to apply function along specified dimensions All, {Dimension}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Require all inputs to have the same data type} requires that all inputs have the same data, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized, {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Best, {Slope} sets the slope for the fixed-point data and {Bias} sets the bias for the fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.
